mapper.select: -- 실제 등록 지자체만 허용하며 연결 공고와 진행 중 첨부 작업은 복구 대상에서 보호한다. SELECT l.id AS registered_source_id,coalesce(nullif(l.collection_endpoint_url,''),l.notice_url) AS registered_source_url, (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_source_links a WHERE a.source_id=s.id) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM announcement_attachment_jobs j WHERE j.source_id=s.id AND j.job_status_code IN ('SCOPE_READY','PENDING','RUNNING','RETRY_WAIT','PAUSED'))) AS blocked FROM announcement_source_snapshots s JOIN local_government_notice_sources l ON l.id=s.local_government_source_id AND l.is_enabled AND l.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE s.id=#{sourceId} AND s.data_purpose_code='PRODUCTION' AND s.provider_code='LOCAL_GOV_NOTICE'
mapper.insert: -- 미리보기만 고정한다. 원문 snapshot/판정/정책/첨부 작업은 변경하지 않는다. INSERT INTO announcement_source_body_refresh_previews (id,source_id,requested_by,base_evaluation_id,content_version_id,rule_release_id, source_version,attachment_version,body_text,body_hash,extractor_version,expires_at) VALUES (#{id},#{sourceId},#{requestedBy},#{baseEvaluationId},#{contentVersionId},#{ruleReleaseId}, #{sourceVersion},#{attachmentVersion},#{bodyText},#{bodyHash},#{extractorVersion},#{expiresAt})
mapper.select: -- source 행 다음 preview 행 잠금. 다른 공고의 preview를 재사용하지 않는다. SELECT id,source_id,requested_by,base_evaluation_id,content_version_id,rule_release_id, source_version,attachment_version,body_text,body_hash,extractor_version,expires_at,applied_evaluation_id FROM announcement_source_body_refresh_previews WHERE id=#{previewId} AND source_id=#{sourceId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: -- 다른 메타데이터/수집 원시 해시는 보존한다. 판정 저장이 같은 transaction에서 버전을 증가시킨다. UPDATE announcement_source_snapshots SET body_text=#{bodyText},updated_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{sourceId} AND classification_row_version=#{expectedVersion} AND NOT is_attachment_review_required

-- 같은 preview 재시도는 저장된 evaluation receipt를 반환한다. UPDATE announcement_source_body_refresh_previews SET applied_evaluation_id=#{evaluationId},applied_at=clock_timestamp() WHERE id=#{previewId} AND applied_evaluation_id IS NULL
